question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**has been**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **sentence **containing the blank 2 **is in present perfect tense**.
 
• **It speaks about the event that took place at an unspecified time in the past**.
 
• **In present perfect tense**, we **use verb constructions such as; has been and have been**.
 
• We use 'have been' with third person plural noun and **we use 'has been' with third person singular noun.**
 
• In the sentence, **"the light" is the singular noun** and hence, the use of "has been" is accurate.
 
• Because of the tense of the sentence, the use of other options will be inaccurate.
 
• Hence, the **correct answer is option 4) has been**.
